text:
Elaine: quick heads-up — post-launch backlog sync at a high level. we have ~18 new reports since the cut; want to split into a small patch vs next milestone. can folks drop quick takes here?
Sam: +1. propose: any reproducible customer-facing error -> patch (P0/P1). UI polish / perf improvements -> enhancement (next milestone) unless frequency > 10% of users.
Grace: linking the top customer reports: https://tickets.internal/RED-312, RED-318, RED-331. RED-312 is a fail-to-load on startup seen by 3 enterprise customers.
Maya: saw a couple of design regressions flagged — dropdown alignment and list truncation. low-risk visuals but impacts perceived quality. would prefer patch if it’s easy.
Anil: if we ship a patch, can we do a canary to 10% of traffic and watch the KV cache hits? also need a rollback plan for dedupe logic change.
Sam: agreed. suggested owner mapping: Sam -> backend fix for RED-312, Maya -> quick CSS patch for dropdowns, Grace -> own customer comms and check repros, Elaine -> coordinate release and acceptance criteria.
Elaine: acceptance checklist (short):
- reproduce on staging with recorded steps
- write a smoke test and add to canary job
- update changelog + customer notes
- no DB migrations in patch releases
If any item fails, escalate to oncall and hold.
Grace: customer comms draft: "we're rolling a patch for startup load failures; ETA 48 hours." will post after Sam confirms fix ETA.
Sam: ETA ~36h for a minimal fix + tests. will open PR tonight.
Sam: backlog filter I used to pull candidates: ```label:post-launch AND (type:bug OR type:enhancement) AND created:>2026-03-15``` tweak as needed.
Maya: can we bundle the tiny CSS tweaks into the same patch if Sam's change is low-risk? reduces ship overhead.
Anil: bundling is fine as long as we keep change surface small. will prepare canary knobs: /api/canary?percent=10 and a quick dashboard to watch error-rate, latency, kv-hit-rate.
Elaine: decision: ship a 0.1.1 patch with RED-312 + dropdown CSS + smoke tests. owners as proposed. rollout: canary 10% -> 50% in 2 hours -> full if stable.
Elaine: follow-ons for the next milestone (sprint): perf tuning on list rendering, deeper triage for RED-331 (sporadic race), and a small UX polish epic.
prod-bot: deploy job scheduled: patch-0.1.1 canary queued by Elaine. ETA: 36h. :rocket:
Grace: thanks — I'll message the affected accounts and loop in support docs update.
Sam: opening PR now, will tag reviewers and link to the smoke test instructions.
Elaine: awesome. we'll reconvene in #product tomorrow 10am if anything blocks. thx everyone :thumbsup:
